prompt:
A high-fidelity desktop website homepage screenshot, first viewport, 1536x1024 landscape, of lumiverse.hr, a senior AI product studio in Zagreb. It must look like a real, shipped, premium website UI, not a poster. Flat front-on browser viewport, crisp UI typography, everything legible.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom:
1. Top navigation bar, thin, full width (about 6% of height): left, the wordmark "LumiVerse" in off-white bold grotesk with a small coral dot before it; center-left, nav links "Work   Services   Research   Studio   Contact" in small grey #7C8088 sans; right, "EN / HR" small grey; far right, a small button with a thin coral outline and off-white label "Start a Project".
2. Hero (the dominant region, about 50% of height): a monumental two-line headline set flush left spanning the left two thirds of the width, very large heavy tight neo-grotesk (like Hanken Grotesk Black), tight negative tracking. Line one: "Generation is cheap." in off-white #EDEDEA. Line two: "Judgement isn't." in coral #FF4D4D. Directly under the headline, a thin grey calibration ruler line with fine tick marks and tiny mono numbers 0 10 20 30.
3. Below the ruler: one sub line in medium grey sans, comfortable size: "A senior AI studio in Zagreb. We build the product and the checks that make it safe to ship." Then a row with a solid coral rectangular button with dark text "Start a Project →" and next to it an underlined off-white text link "See the work".
4. Lower third: a row of three equal horizontal data plates styled like calibration certificates: dark #15171B panels, 1px hairline grey borders, small L-shaped registration ticks at each corner, square corners. Each plate: a small realistic dark product screenshot thumbnail on the left, and on the right small text in a technical monospace:
   Plate 1: "MOJ KOLEGA" title, "AI employee for webshops", readout "24/7", and a small stamped coral "PASS" mark.
   Plate 2: "BRIDJ" title, "Embedded tech lead, UK platform", readout "17 services", and a small stamped coral "PASS" mark.
   Plate 3: "AIR-LASER" title, "Physics design study", readout "49 pages", and a small stamped grey mark reading "COMPUTED, NOT BUILT".

BACKGROUND AND MATERIAL: near-black field #08090B overlaid with an etched measurement graticule: very thin grey rules #2A2D33 forming a sparse grid, tick marks along the left and top edges of the viewport, tiny grey coordinate numbers in mono, all very subtle; a fine dot grid at the intersections, dots slightly brighter behind the headline and fading outward. Precise, instrument-like, quiet, engineered.

COLOR DISCIPLINE: text off-white #EDEDEA, secondary grey #7C8088. Exactly one accent, coral #FF4D4D, used ONLY on "Judgement isn't.", the coral dot and nav button outline, the solid CTA button, and the two PASS stamps. Nothing else coral.

AVOID: neon glow, purple, gradients, glassmorphism, blurred blobs, bento cards, rounded pill shapes, 3D renders, stock photos, extra text, prices, misspellings.
